summary: Frontend-only test of CP4.26 (Şirket Chip Filtresi + Şirketteki herkesi seç) in ATAMA MATRİSİ view. All 6 requested features verified working. Also ran regression on matrix-select-all + LİSTE view — both intact.
critical_code_review_comments: UserManagement.jsx is ~1400 lines — consider splitting matrix view into its own component (MatrixView.jsx) for maintainability.
Chip data-testid uses raw company label (may contain spaces/special chars), e.g. 'matrix-chip-toggle-Test Company A'. Works but consider sanitizing or using company_id for more robust selectors.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing 7 companies + Bireysel group (23 non-admin users total)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Environment: overdue tasks modal ('SÜRESİ GEÇMİŞ GÖREV') auto-opens after admin login and blocks interaction. Neither Escape nor plain X clicks worked reliably — the working close was: page.evaluate() to find the smallest button (svg-only) inside the modal and click it. Use this pattern to bypass. Matrix view accessible via: login → open-settings → settings-tab-users → user-view-toggle-matrix. Data has 7 companies + 15 Bireysel + 1 admin (serkan).

test_results_per_feature.1_chip_bar_visible: PASS — matrix-company-chips container renders below matrix-filter. matrix-chip-all present with text 'Tümü (23)' (active by default with cyan styling). 7 company chips + Bireysel chip, each with Building2 icon and (N) count label.
test_results_per_feature.2_chip_toggle_filter: PASS — clicking matrix-chip-toggle-CoDS_17c701 filtered rows 23→1. Chip parent got class 'border-purple-400 bg-purple-500/15'. Second click toggled off (back to 23 rows).
test_results_per_feature.3_select_all_in_company: PASS — clicking matrix-chip-select-CoDS_17c701 opened bulk-assign-bar with '1 seçili' and toast 'CoDS_17c701: 1 kişi seçildi'. Worked without chip filter being active.
test_results_per_feature.4_select_all_header_respects_filter: PASS — matrix-select-all checked all visible rows; works together with chip filter.
test_results_per_feature.6_regression_list_view_and_bulk_bar: PASS — LİSTE view still renders 8 company groups; bulk-assign-bar, select-all, matrix-add-select, bulk-assign-clear all functional.
